  2. A word will appear briefly
  3. A sentence will appear - press the SPACEBAR when you finish reading it
  4. You'll be asked if the word and sentence are related


To respond:

Press the left arrow on the number pad if they ARE related

Press the right arrow on the number pad if they ARE NOT related
